result.instructions: Tools for SupportBee, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many tickets are waiting in the shared inbox right now?"; "Search tickets from jane@acme.com and summarize her issue."; "How many tickets did we get over the last 30 days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SupportBee data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run supportbee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run supportbee_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run supportbee_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. supportbee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: supportbee_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List tickets of the shared inbox, newest activity first, with filters (assignee, team, label, requester, dates, spam/trash/archived). By default archived, spam and trashed tickets are left out. Each ticket has id, subject, labels, requester, assignee, replies_count, comments_count, unanswered, archived and the first message text (cut). With total_only=true only the number of matching tickets comes back. GET /tickets.

archived.description: true = only archived tickets, false = no archived tickets (default), any = both.

spam.description: Include tickets marked as spam (default false).

has_replies.description: true = only tickets that have replies, false = only tickets without replies.

max_replies.description: Only tickets with this number of replies (not with has_replies=false).

assigned_user.description: me = assigned to the token's user, an agent id (from supportbee_list_users), any = assigned to someone, none = unassigned.

assigned_team.description: mine = assigned to the user's teams, a team id (from supportbee_list_teams), none = no team.

label.description: Only tickets with this label name (supportbee_list_labels).

since.description: Only tickets with last activity after this time (date, ISO date-time or Unix timestamp).

until.description: Only tickets with last activity before this time (date, ISO date-time or Unix timestamp).

requester_emails.description: Only tickets from these requester e-mail addresses (max 10).

total_only.description: Return only the total number of matching tickets.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

annotations.title: List tickets

tools.name: supportbee_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Full-text search over tickets (subject, body, requester) with SupportBee's search syntax, newest activity first. Spam and trash are excluded unless asked. GET /tickets/search.

spam.description: Include tickets marked as spam (default false).

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use next_page from the previous reply.

annotations.title: Search tickets

tools.name: supportbee_get_ticket
tools.title: Get a ticket
tools.description: One ticket with subject, requester, labels, assignees, state and the first message text. Replies and comments are separate calls. GET /tickets/{id}.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: Get a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_list_replies
tools.title: List the replies of a ticket
tools.description: The public replies (the conversation with the customer) of a ticket, oldest first, as text. GET /tickets/{id}/replies.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: List the replies of a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_get_reply
tools.title: Get one reply of a ticket
tools.description: One reply of a ticket (text, replier, cc/bcc). GET /tickets/{ticket_id}/replies/{id}.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: Get one reply of a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_list_comments
tools.title: List the internal comments of a ticket
tools.description: The internal comments (visible to agents only, never e-mailed) of a ticket, oldest first, as text. GET /tickets/{id}/comments.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: List the internal comments of a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_get_ticket_audit
tools.title: Get the audit trail of a ticket
tools.description: What happened to a ticket and who did it (assignments, label changes, replies, archiving) with timestamps. GET /tickets/{id}/audit.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: Get the audit trail of a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: All custom labels of the company (name and color). Use a label name with supportbee_add_label or the label filter. GET /labels.

annotations.title: List labels

tools.name: supportbee_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: The teams of the company (id, name), optionally only those that have users in them, or only the token user's teams. GET /teams.

with_users.description: Only teams that have users in them (SupportBee's with_users filter; it does not add the member list).

mine_only.description: Only the teams of the user who owns the token.

annotations.title: List teams

tools.name: supportbee_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The agents, admins and collaborators of the desk (id, name, e-mail, role, teams), or customer groups. Use the id as assigned_user or user_id. GET /users.

with_roles.description: Roles to include (default admin, agent, collaborator).

with_invited.description: Include users who were invited but have not joined yet (default false).

annotations.title: List users

tools.name: supportbee_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: One user or customer with role, teams, ticket counts and a few of their recent tickets. GET /users/{id}.

max_tickets.description: How many of the user's tickets to include (default 5).

annotations.title: Get a user

tools.name: supportbee_list_snippets
tools.title: List snippets
tools.description: The canned replies (snippets) of the company: name, tags and text, to reuse in a reply. GET /snippets.

annotations.title: List snippets

tools.name: supportbee_list_forwarding_addresses
tools.title: List forwarding addresses
tools.description: The support e-mail addresses (forwarding addresses) of the desk: id, name, the address tickets arrive at and the from address. GET /emails.

annotations.title: List forwarding addresses

tools.name: supportbee_get_report
tools.title: Get a report
tools.description: A report as time-series data points (value, timestamp): tickets_count, replies_count or avg_first_response_time, optionally for one agent, team or label. Needs an admin token. GET /reports/{report}.

since.description: Start of the period (date, ISO date-time or Unix timestamp).

annotations.title: Get a report

tools.name: supportbee_reply_to_ticket
tools.title: Reply to a ticket (sends an e-mail)
tools.description: WRITE: SENDS AN E-MAIL to the customer. Posts a public reply on ONE ticket; SupportBee e-mails it to the ticket's requester and to the cc/bcc addresses you list (at most 10 addresses in total). It cannot be recalled. The reply comes from the token's user. For a note only your team sees, use supportbee_add_comment. POST /tickets/{id}/replies.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

text.description: The reply text (plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs).

cc.description: Extra recipients in cc (cc + bcc together at most 10).

bcc.description: Extra recipients in bcc (cc + bcc together at most 10).

annotations.title: Reply to a ticket (sends an e-mail)

tools.name: supportbee_add_comment
tools.title: Add an internal comment to a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: adds an internal comment to a ticket. Comments are visible to your agents only and are never e-mailed to the customer. POST /tickets/{id}/comments.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

text.description: The comment text (plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs).

annotations.title: Add an internal comment to a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_add_label
tools.title: Add a label to a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: adds an existing label to a ticket (404 if the label does not exist; names come from supportbee_list_labels). Safe to repeat. POST /tickets/{id}/labels/{label}.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

label.description: The label name, exactly as in supportbee_list_labels.

annotations.title: Add a label to a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_remove_label
tools.title: Remove a label from a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: removes a label from a ticket (the label itself stays; 404 if the ticket does not have it). DELETE /tickets/{id}/labels/{label}.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: Remove a label from a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_assign_ticket
tools.title: Assign a ticket to a user or a team
tools.description: WRITE: assigns a ticket to ONE agent (user_id) or ONE team (team_id), not both. A ticket that belongs to a team can only go to a member of that team; assigning to another team removes the user assignee. The customer is not e-mailed (SupportBee may notify the assigned agent). POST /tickets/{id}/user_assignment or /team_assignment.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: Assign a ticket to a user or a team

tools.name: supportbee_unassign_ticket
tools.title: Remove the user or team assignment of a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: clears the user assignee or the team assignee of a ticket. DELETE /tickets/{id}/user_assignment or /team_assignment.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

annotations.title: Remove the user or team assignment of a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_set_ticket_archived
tools.title: Archive or un-archive a ticket
tools.description: WRITE: archives a ticket (archived=true, it leaves the open inbox) or moves it back (archived=false). Nothing is deleted or sent. POST/DELETE /tickets/{id}/archive.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

archived.description: true = archive, false = move back to the inbox.

annotations.title: Archive or un-archive a ticket

tools.name: supportbee_set_ticket_answered
tools.title: Mark a ticket answered or unanswered
tools.description: WRITE: marks a ticket as answered (answered=true) or unanswered (answered=false) without sending anything. POST/DELETE /tickets/{id}/answered.

ticket_id.description: The SupportBee ticket id (the number in the ticket URL; from supportbee_list_tickets).

answered.description: true = mark answered, false = mark unanswered.

annotations.title: Mark a ticket answered or unanswered

prompts.title: Get started with SupportBee
